name: Spicy Tex-Mex Pasta Salad with Beans, Corn, Peppers, Tomato & Cheddar

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and rinse under cold water to cool; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g penne pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
6 tomatoes
3 orange bell peppers
3 jalapeño peppers
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into a large bowl.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl with the lime juice, along with oil and spices, then stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 shallot
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the bowl.
Rinse corn under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Add to the bowl.
Coarsely grate cheese. Add to the bowl, along with cooled pasta, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
